surface: static web prototype in local Google Chrome via Playwright screenshots
inspectionMethod: Direct visual inspection of generated PNG screenshots after automated browser capture

findings.actual: The B/frontpage hero headline and hero supporting text render dark against a dark night-mode gradient, making the main hero content difficult to read.
findings.sourceCause: outputs/首页三套方案-互动设计稿.html lines 225-227 set hero text to var(--color-paper-elevated), which becomes dark in [data-theme="night"] in outputs/首页三套方案-tokens.css lines 41-50.

findings.actual: The global H1 breaks the Chinese phrase into short chunks at both 320px and 768px, and the B hero headline breaks into unnecessarily short lines at 768px despite available horizontal space.
findings.sourceCause: outputs/首页三套方案-互动设计稿.html lines 48-56 constrain h1 to max-width: 14ch with large display type; line 226 constrains the hero h3 to max-width: 15ch.
